context: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Inject intramuscularly or subcutaneously preferably in the neck area using aseptic technique. Calves - 1/2 to 1 mL, Adult Cattle - 2 to 4 mL Yearling Cattle- 1 to 2 mL These suggested dosage may be repeated after 60 days, if necessary.
